english.title: Cause a vehicle / aircraft / animal / thing to enter into the Protected Area of AWE Burghfield
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused

(A)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..),]_
(C)_[an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..),]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY THE THING..)]_

to enter into the Protected Area within the Atomic Weapons Establishment, Burghfield
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 5(d) and 9 of the Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE) Burghfield Byelaws 2010 and section 17(2) of the Military Lands Act 1892.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Byelaw 10 of the Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE) Burghfield Byelaws 2010 provides that these byelaws shall not apply to anything done (a) by a lawful user in connection with the discharge of his functions; or (b) by a person acting under and in accordance with any permission given in writing by the Appointed Person.
(ii) Byelaw 12 of the Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE) Burghfield Byelaws 2010 provides that (a) the Appointed Person; (b) any officer, warrant officer, or non-commissioned officer in uniform and acting under the instructions of the Appointed Person; and (c) any other Crown servant authorised in writing by the Appointed Person are authorised to remove from the Protected Areas and Controlled Areas and to take into custody without warrant any person committing an offence against these byelaws and to remove any vehicle, aircraft, animal or thing in contravention of these byelaws from the Protected Area.
